rollups.text: Car fuel-efficiency and accessory timeline: A few months before 2023-05-20, the user's car achieved 30 mpg in city driving; on 2023-05-20 the user considered a tune-up, noted the oil change was about 1,000 miles overdue, and planned to check the air filter, spark plugs, and tire pressure. By 2023-05-24, city mileage was about 28 mpg; the user considered a new air filter and checking tire pressure, and asked whether a Wix 51348 fit the user's 2018 Honda Civic. On 2023-05-20, the user chose an unspecified dash cam around $150 with good reviews, collision detection, and parking mode, but purchase was unconfirmed; on 2023-05-24 the user was still researching dash cams and considering mounting options. The user also decided to get a phone mount on 2023-05-20, without selecting or confirming purchase of one.

Basketball return and practice timeline: After a six-month break, the user resumed recreational basketball about three weeks before 2023-05-20 and played with friends at the community-center court on Sundays at 9 a.m., usually 3-on-3 or 4-on-4. On 2023-05-14, the user made three three-pointers in a row despite feeling the game was tough after staying up late. By 2023-05-20, the user felt rusty but was improving and focused on jump-shot form, endurance, and stamina; the user intended to practice regularly and was incorporating leg and core strength work. The group was competitive but supportive, with friendly advice and trash talk.

Farm expansion and cow-preparation timeline: By 2023-05-24, the user operated a small farm with chickens and a dairy goat named Ginger, had repaired the chicken-coop roof during 2023-05-15..2023-05-21, and was considering building a pigpen. The user planned to get a dairy cow, considering Jersey or Brown Swiss, and planned further research and visits to local farms before choosing. The user was preparing barn living quarters and a milking area, renovating the barn personally while hiring contractors for specialized electrical and plumbing work, and setting up fencing and pasture. The user had developed a homemade feed mix for the chickens and Ginger that saved about $50 monthly and was still being fine-tuned; the user was interested in how it might work for a future cow. The user also composted animal manure for the garden and sought other uses.

rollups.text: Home purchase timeline: On 2023-05-29, the user was in the process of buying a house in Oakwood, had been approved for a $450,000, 30-year fixed mortgage at 3.75%, and had made an offer and negotiated the price; the house price exceeded the loan amount. The assistant suggested locations, camera backpacks, and filters; the user did not confirm purchasing any suggested gear.

On 2023-05-20, the user explored Jira and Trello, including their pricing and suitability for David, and asked how to apply Agile to writing projects. The user chose to try Ulysses for distraction-free writing and the possibility of creating Trello cards from within the app. The assistant described a possible Ulysses–Trello setup, but the user did not confirm implementing it.

The business was considering improvements to its supplement-shopping and subscription website and was trying a bimonthly delivery model in which customers paid for and received a two-month supply at once. The assistant suggested offering monthly and two-month options and surveying customers; no decision on those suggestions was recorded.

The user bought a Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW camera bag on 2023-03-10, which fit their cameras, lenses, and accessories.
